events.title: Thousands attend Prague Pride parade
events.description: Participants observed a minute of silence in memory of the victims of a van ramming near the CSD parade in Berlin. The march was accompanied by enhanced security measures.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Thousands attend Prague Pride parade

events.title: US Senate confirms Trump loyalist Todd Blanche as new AG
events.description: Republicans dropped their opposition and confirmed President Donald Trump's former defense lawyer to a Cabinet position. Now, Todd Blanche will act as the nation's top law enforcement officer.

events.title: Bulgaria: Unknown drone explodes near Romanian border
events.description: A drone that entered Bulgaria's airspace exploded near the Romanian border and the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, the Bulgarian prime minister said. Bulgaria summoned the Ukrainian ambassador for consultations.

events.title: Colombia: Trump ally De la Espriella takes office
events.description: Conservative Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in as Colombia's president, promising to crack down on armed drug gangs.

events.title: Trump to appeal ballroom construction halt to Supreme Court
events.description: A US Court of Appeals upheld a ruling that saying Trump cannot build a White House ballroom without congressional approval. The president vowed to appeal what he called an "unjust decision."

events.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute
events.description: Spain on Saturday introduced temporary border checks on travellers arriving from Italy, escalating a dispute between the EU partners over migration. The move follows Italy’s decision to impose similar controls after more than 70,000 migrants crossed into Spain’s Ceuta enclave from Morocco, most of whom later returned.

events.title: Women's Tour de France: Defending champion Pauline Ferrand-Prévot pulls out of race
events.description: French cyclist and defending champion Pauline Ferrand-Prévot pulled out of the Women's Tour de France ahead of Saturday's 8th and penultimate stage due to feeling unwell. An Olympic champion in mountain biking at the 2024 Paris Olympics, Ferrand-Prévôt won the Women's Tour de France in her debut last year.

events.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche, Trump's former lawyer, as Attorney General
events.description: The US Senate has confirmed Donald Trump’s former personal lawyer, Todd Blanche, as attorney general, despite opposition from Democrats who accused the president of politicising the Department of Justice. Blanche previously represented Trump as his private attorney in several criminal trials before joining the administration. Camille Knight has more.

events.title: Irish government jet flies to Dubai to extradite alleged crime boss Daniel Kinahan
events.description: An Irish government jet has flown to Dubai for the extradition of alleged gang boss Daniel Kinahan.

events.title: Infantino denies UEFA paid off alleged mistress while he was general secretary
events.description: Gianni Infantino has "strongly" denied that UEFA paid off an alleged mistress while he was the European football governing body's general secretary.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Infantino denies UEFA paid off alleged mistress while he was general secretary

events.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travelers in tit-for-tat move over Ceuta migrants row
events.description: The diplomatic spat between Spain and Italy over migrant arrivals at Ceuta has escalated after Madrid announced border controls on Italian travelers after Rome had earlier imposed similar sanctions on visitors from Spain

events.title: Lebanon detains Assad-era general and weighs his handover to Syria over alleged crimes
events.description: Lebanese authorities have detained a former senior Syrian military officer who commanded an army division under ousted President Bashar Assad

events.title: High divers take the plunge in the Seine in a new test of Paris’ reclaimed river
events.description: Paris is hosting its first high-diving competition in the Seine, with athletes diving from a 20-meter platform near the Eiffel Tower

events.title: Eastern China braces for Typhoon Dolphin, shutting schools and tourist activities
events.description: Authorities in eastern China are shutting schools and tourist sites as Typhoon Dolphin heads for the coast
events.ticker_label: 🌪️ Eastern China braces for Typhoon Dolphin, shutting schools and tourist activities

events.title: Argentines pray that Pope Leo's visit alleviates their economic stress
events.description: Pope Leo XIV plans to visit Argentina in November, marking the first papal visit in nearly 40 years

events.title: Spanish-led police raid smashes a vast Mediterranean smuggling network, arresting 78
events.description: Spanish authorities have dismantled a major criminal network involved in trafficking migrants, drugs and weapons across the Western Mediterranean

events.title: For Brazil’s Indigenous youth, visibility is resistance
events.description: As climate change reshapes Indigenous territories across Brazil, a new generation is turning to culture and digital platforms to defend their lands and their future.

events.title: Florida business owners allegedly scattered 1,500 mothballs on beach to send endangered birds packing
events.description: Two St. Pete Beach business owners allegedly spread 1,500 toxic mothballs on sand to stop black skimmers from nesting, now facing felony charges.

events.title: Cornell bans bear butchering after students carved up creature in dorm kitchen
events.description: Cornell University now bans wild game processing in dorm kitchens after two students went viral for butchering a black bear in Ganędagǫ Hall.

events.title: Teen accused of killing Citadel cadet and friend had lengthy rap sheet with few consequences, sheriff says
events.description: The 17-year-old suspect in the DeLand double murder had charges dropped or dismissed repeatedly since 2021, Volusia County Sheriff Chitwood says.

events.title: Actress convicted as accessory after double murder made disturbing remark before killings, former friend says
events.description: Daniel Wozniak's ex-fiancée, Rachel Buffett, is explored in the true-crime series "A Killer Among Friends," and a former friend recalls chilling red flags.

events.title: More than 50 bodies found decomposing inside Chicago funeral home after neighbors complained of 'stench'
events.description: Over 50 bodies were found decomposing at a South Side funeral home after months of complaints about a foul stench from nearby Chicago residents.

events.title: Chilling new video shows armed citizens, off-duty trooper confront In-N-Out gunman during deadly rampage
events.description: Newly released video shows the Twin Falls, Idaho, In-N-Out Burger gunman's deadly path and how an off-duty trooper and armed bystander confronted him.
events.ticker_label: 🚨 Chilling new video shows armed citizens, off-duty trooper confront In-N-Out gunman during deadly rampage

events.title: San Francisco dad questioned by park rangers for teaching his own kids tennis at public court
events.description: Sam Dogen says San Francisco park rangers asked whether he had a tennis permit while he was practicing with his two children on a public court.

events.title: WATCH: Wild traffic stop turns chaotic as suspect drives off with one cop inside, drags second officer
events.description: Body camera video captures the moment Shakoi Donovan allegedly sped off with a Eustis, Florida, officer pinned inside his car during a DUI stop.

events.title: Vehicle narrowly avoids slamming into driver on side of Ohio highway, dramatic video shows
events.description: Video from the Ohio Department of Transportation captures the moment a driver leaps onto a highway divider seconds before a sedan slams into his SUV.

events.title: Gen Keane questions whether Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Qatar can be trusted in Iran talks
events.description: Retired Gen. Jack Keane accuses Pakistan, Qatar and Saudi Arabia of being compromised mediators who steer Trump away from military pressure on Iran.

events.title: Terrifying 'human safaris' on display in shocking video that reveals depths of Russia's deadly campaign
events.description: Video shows a Russian drone stalking a vegetable vendor through a Kherson market before detonating near him, in what Zelenskyy calls a "safari."
